raw_response: {"diagnosis": "On 2026-01-17 the source began sending reversals as separate REVERSAL rows with orig_txn_id, leaving the original rows as POSTED instead of updating them to REVERSED. The silver filter on status='POSTED' therefore keeps the reversed originals, which inflates the gold totals. The fix excludes originals referenced by a REVERSAL row, which matches the old behaviour where reversed originals were dropped.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL)"}}
